movement_source: row 'Cash earnings', column FY24 -> column FY25
headline: NAB's cash earnings decreased by $11 million to $7,091 million in FY25 (FY24: $7,102 million). Total operating income increased by $577 million (2.8%) to $20,813 million, driven by higher net interest income (+$644m) partially offset by lower other operating income (-$67m). Operating expenses rose $435 million (4.6%) to $9,848 million. Credit impairment charges increased by $105 million to $833 million. Tax expense increased by $27 million to $3,002 million.

drivers.narrative: Increased by $644 million or 3.8% to $17,398 million. Driven by higher average interest earning assets (+$22.5bn, +2.3%) and a 3 bps increase in Group NIM (1.74% vs 1.71%). Includes a $74 million decrease from economic hedges, offset in other operating income.
Decreased by $67 million or 1.9% to $3,415 million. Net fees and commissions fell $132 million (5.8%), trading income rose $33 million (2.8%), and other income increased $32 million.

Increased by $435 million or 4.6% to $9,848 million. Personnel expenses rose $271 million (including $101m payroll review/remediation), technology expenses up $71 million, general expenses up $81 million (including $29m remediation), and occupancy/depreciation up $12 million.
Increased by $105 million to $833 million (FY24: $728 million). This represents a negative contribution to earnings as the charge grew.

notable_items: Payroll review and remediation costs ($130 million total impact on expenses)

evidence_records.quote: Group cash earnings reconciliation to statutory net profit

NAB uses cash earnings (rather than statutory net profit attributable to owners of the Company) for its internal management reporting purposes and considers it a better reflection of the Group’s underlying performance.

Cash earnings is not a statutory financial measure and is not presented in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards nor audited or reviewed in accordance with Australian Auditing Standards. Cash earnings is calculated by excluding discontinued operations and certain other items which are included within the statutory net profit attributable to owners of the Company.
